mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT oi.product_id FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} AND o.status IN(3,4) AND o.deleted=0 ORDER BY oi.create_time DESC

SELECT oi.product_id productId,p.category_id categoryId,SUM(oi.quantity) quantity,SUM(oi.quantity*oi.price) amount,MAX(o.create_time) lastBuy FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN product p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} AND o.status IN(3,4) AND o.deleted=0 GROUP BY oi.product_id,p.category_id
